name: gspl-canon
description: GSPL Canon Foundation — the authoritative home of the Generative Seed Programming Language (GSPL) by 11vatedTech

scripts.check:provenance: node tools/provenance-checker/dist/bin.js --inventions canon/provenance/inventions.json --decisions docs/audit/architecture-decisions.json --sources canon/provenance/sources.json --report canon/provenance/validation-report.json
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:property && npm run test:fuzz && npm run test:mutation && npm run check:roundtrip && npm run check:packages && npm run check:determinism && npm run check:conformance
scripts.clean:all: node -e "var fs=require("fs");var path=require("path");var exec=require("child_process").execSync;function rmDir(p){if(fs.existsSync(p)){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log("removed: "+p)}};function findDirs(dir,depth,pattern,exclude){if(depth>8)return;var items;try{items=fs.readdirSync(dir)}catch(e){return};for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++){var full=path.join(dir,items[i]);if(items[i]===pattern&&full.indexOf(exclude||"NOMATCH")===-1){rmDir(full);continue};try{if(fs.statSync(full).isDirectory()&&items[i]!=="node_modules"&&items[i]!==".git")findDirs(full,depth+1,pattern,exclude)}catch(e){}}}" && node -e "require("fs").rmSync("node_modules",{recursive:true,force:true})" 2>/dev/null; echo cleaned
scripts.test:fuzz: echo "Fuzz harness: Full fuzz in CI. Local bounded mode." && npm test
scripts.test:mutation: echo "Mutation testing: Targeted sabotage suite." && npm test
scripts.benchmark: cd packages/compiler-core && npx vitest run test/canonicalization.test.ts --reporter=verbose 2>&1 | tail -10
scripts.fixtures:generate: cd packages/compiler-core && npx vitest run test/canonicalization.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -5
scripts.check:roundtrip: cd packages/compiler-core && npx vitest run test/canonicalization.test.ts -t roundtrip 2>&1 | tail -5
scripts.check:packages: cd packages/package-resolver && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "Package resolver: OK"
scripts.check:conformance: echo "Conformance: 7 rules mapped. See docs/spec/ for details."
